input: Draft terms and conditions for my freelance services

gold.taskTitle: Draft Terms and Conditions for Freelance Services
gold.taskDescription: Write a custom terms and conditions document to govern the user's freelance service agreements with clients.

questions.title: What type of freelance services do you offer?
questions.description: Identify the specific nature of the freelance work, such as graphic design, writing, software development, consulting, etc.

questions.title: Who are your typical clients, businesses or individuals?
questions.description: Understand the client profile to tailor the language, formality, and legal scope of the terms.

questions.title: Which country or jurisdiction governs your contracts?
questions.description: Determine the applicable legal jurisdiction so the terms and conditions comply with local laws and regulations.

questions.title: How do you currently structure your payment and invoicing?
questions.description: Clarify payment terms such as upfront deposits, milestone payments, net payment periods, and late fee policies.

questions.title: Do you need clauses covering intellectual property ownership?
questions.description: Find out whether IP rights transfer to the client upon payment or if the user retains any ownership or licensing rights.

questions.title: Have you had specific disputes or problems with past clients?
questions.description: Identify pain points from prior experience, such as scope creep, non-payment, or cancellations, to ensure the document addresses them.

questions.title: Will this document be a standalone contract or an addendum?
questions.description: Clarify whether the terms and conditions will serve as the sole agreement or be attached to an existing proposal or statement of work.
